'''Gern Frezik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in the [[Galactic War]], he was stationed in [[Coronet City Spaceport/Legends|Coronet Spaceport]] in the [[Incorporation Islands]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Officer Frezik appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Social Items Vendor for Imperial players on Corellia.<ref name="TOR" /> The ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', released alongside the game, identified him as Gern Frezik.
